overview_description.description: eben provides solutions to assist employers in finding ways to serve employees by providing a benefit of appreciation and a reward for hard work and commitment at work. They offer comprehensive, secure managed software solutions that assist businesses in meeting the needs of their employees through an all-inclusive platform of employee-centric engagement utilities. eBen makes people's engagement & rewardseasier & more effective for everyone. Our flexible managed SaaS solutions act as an active asset for our clients to ENGAGE, ENABLE and EMERGE thousands of employees as they benefit every day. We love what we do and we work closely with all our clients, partners, and employee benefit providers to deliver world-class services supporting thousands of corporates.
